h: Vayetzei Ois 8 · Hidden and Revealed Sevens: Rachel's Sons, Moshe and the Well

p: In the holy Zohar on this parashah
the Jubilee is hidden and not revealed,
Come and see: at the time
and the holy Zohar elaborates there.
is called in the holy Zohar “Imma” (Mother),
for she gives birth to Vav and Heh,
as written in the holy Zohar.
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק א, קעו עַמּוּד ב),
are bound one to the other”
and even though there are claims
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק א, צג עַמּוּד א).
that his bed (his offspring) is complete;
while Yosef is the one who clarifies
and Israel are called by his name,
is the guardian of the covenant,
and from this comes the victory,
only by the hand of the sons

Elazar: אָמַר רִבִּי אֶלְעָזָר, תָּא חֲזֵי, בְּכָל אֲתַר יוֹבְלָא סָתִים דְּלָא אִתְגַּלְּיָא וּשְׁמִטָּה אִתְגַּלְּיָא. תָּא חֲזֵי, בְּשַׁעְתָּא דְּיַעֲקֹב פָּלַח שֶׁבַע שְׁנִין קַדְמָאִין, נָפְקָא קָלָא וְאָמַר, יַעֲקֹב, מִן הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם — the Jubilee is always concealed and the Shemitah revealed; when Yaakov served his first seven years a voice proclaimed "from world to world" (Tehillim 106:48), the hidden upper world of the Jubilee. The daf is confirmed: both paragraphs stand on 153b.

rich.text: (Pinchas). The Vav as the six sefirot that issue from the upper Heh (Binah, "Imma"): אוף הכי ו' דכליל שית ספיראן — "so too the Vav, which includes six sefirot"; the same phrase Rav Tzadok uses at [1.15–1.16]. The pairing of Leah's six sons and daughter with the six sefirot and Malchut is the Zohar's own, see the next note.

rich.text: (Vayetzei). רָחֵל אוֹלִידַת תְּרֵין צַדִּיקִים ... וְעַל דָּא, יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִין תְּרֵין צַדִּיקִין נִינְהוּ. יוֹסֵף זָכָה לְמֶהוֵי צַדִּיק לְעֵילָא, בְּגִין דְּנָטַר אָת קַיָּימָא. בִּנְיָמִין אִיהוּ צַדִּיק לְתַתָּא, לְאִתְעַטְּרָא שְׁמִטָּה בֵּין תְּרֵי צַדִּיקֵי — Rachel bore two tzaddikim; Yosef merited to be the tzaddik above because he guarded the covenant, Binyamin is the tzaddik below, so that the Shemitah is crowned between two tzaddikim. The paragraph just before (
) says לאה אולידת שית בנין וברתא חדא ... שית סטרין, the source of [1.18–1.19].

p: And this is what is said:
for the beginning of the conquest
who was commanded to carry out
and it was not completed then.
came the essential eradication of Amalek;
that is, to eliminate the evil.
the victory over the idolatrous nations
to eliminate the evil from Israel.
for Yaakov did not know of them,
because they were of the Jubilee;
the endeavor of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
to clarify in the hidden realms
that Israel are bound at the root
so that “our will is to do Your will.”
the seven years that are revealed
that in deed and action too,
who “all his days did not sin,”
as written in the holy Zohar.
In truth, there was no need
for Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
to work more than seven years;
for once he had been clarified
זָכָה גַּם לְמִדַּת רָחֵל גַּם כֵּן;
he merited the attribute of Rachel as well;
in the wedding feast of Leah
was in order to be clarified
as written in the holy Zohar.
who is “the culmination of the body,”

h: Moshe the Soul, Yaakov the Body

p: are from the side of the Central Pillar,
and that one from the soul.”
Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
and knew no evil at all,
so too Moshe: when he was born
the house was filled with light
and he was like Adam HaRishon
And heaven is called the soul,
was like the face of the sun”
for Yaakov had already clarified them
in the seven years he worked
to clarify that the bodies of Israel
who no longer had any involvement
for he brought down the words of Torah,
which are the root of the souls of Israel,
who correspond to the six hundred thousand
in the gift of his portion”;
and not a day of the body”
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב, רה סוֹף עַמּוּד א),
(as written in Zohar II, end of 205a);

rich.text: (Tikkun 13). ויעקב ודאי איהו דיוקנא דעמודא דאמצעיתא מסטרא דלבר. והא משה תמן הוה אלא מסטרא דלגאו הוה. דא מגופא ודא מנשמתא — Yaakov is the image of the Central Pillar from outside, Moshe from inside: one of the body, one of the soul.
